- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

All five items found. Findings:

**1. ChangeExtractorService** — `/testbed/src/main/services/team/ChangeExtractorService.ts` (TypeScript, ESM with `@main`/`@shared` path aliases)
- `getTaskChanges(teamName, taskId, options?)` at lines 123–266; options include `owner`, `status`, `intervals`, `since`, `summaryOnly`.
- Caching: three in-class Maps (lines 52–57): `cache` (30s TTL), `taskChangeCache` (20s TTL, key `task:${teamName}:${taskId}`, only set when `includeDetails` i.e. `summaryOnly !== true`), and `parsedSnippetsCache` (mtime + 20s TTL, lines 458–460, 599–602).

**2. TaskBoundaryParser** — `/testbed/src/main/services/team/TaskBoundaryParser.ts`
- `MCP_TASK_BOUNDARY_TOOLS` set (`task_start`, `task_complete`, `task_set_status`) at line 34; `DetectedMechanism` type ('TaskUpdate' | 'mcp' | 'none') line 36.
- `extractTaskUpdateBoundaries` (line 175) reads `toolName === 'TaskUpdate'` (189) and `input.taskId` (194). MCP boundaries around line 246–267 read `input.taskId` (246) and map `task_start`→'start' / `task_complete`→'complete' (256–257). Public `getTaskScope(filePath, taskId)` at 151; boundaries grouped per taskId at 293–302. Exported via barrel `/testbed/src/main/services/team/index.ts`. Test: `/testbed/test/main/services/team/TaskBoundaryParser.test.ts`.

**3. Change review renderer store** — `/testbed/src/renderer/store/slices/changeReviewSlice.ts` (Zustand slice)
- State fields: `activeChangeSet` (57), `selectedReviewFilePath` (60), `changeStatsCache` (61); `fetchTaskChanges` implemented at 281; `checkTaskHasChanges` at 981 with module-level `taskChangesNegativeCache = new Map<string, number>()` (line 9) plus an in-flight dedupe tracker (line 6 comment) and `taskChangesPresent`-style presence cache near line 81.
- Consumer: `/testbed/src/renderer/components/team/review/ChangeReviewDialog.tsx`.

**4. PluginCatalogItem / PluginCatalogService**
- Type: `/testbed/src/shared/types/extensions/plugin.ts` (`interface PluginCatalogItem` line 9; `EnrichedPlugin extends PluginCatalogItem` line 45; `inferCapabilities` line 56).
- Service: `/testbed/src/main/services/extensions/catalog/PluginCatalogService.ts` — class at line 146; `getPlugins(forceRefresh)` 155, `getPluginReadme` 178, `resolvePlugin` 217, `fetchCatalog` 241.
- Test: `/testbed/test/main/services/extensions/PluginCatalogService.test.ts`. Also referenced in `ExtensionFacadeService.ts` and `src/shared/utils/extensionNormalizers.ts`.

**5. TeamMcpConfigBuilder** — `/testbed/src/main/services/team/TeamMcpConfigBuilder.ts`
- `MCP_SERVER_NAME = 'agent-teams'` (line 14); `class TeamMcpConfigBuilder` (96); `writeConfigFile()` (97–120) writes `agent-teams-mcp-{uuid}.json` to `os.tmpdir()/claude-team-mcp` with `mcpServers["agent-teams"]` command/args via `resolveMcpLaunchSpec()` (pnpm/tsx or built entry).
- Note: `.claude.json` reading is **not** in this file; it lives in `/testbed/src/main/services/extensions/state/McpInstallationStateService.ts` (lines 5–7, 42, 66 — `~/.claude.json` → `mcpServers`).
- Usage: injected in `TeamProvisioningService.ts` (line 1144), invoked at lines 2390 and 2737, passed as `--mcp-config` (2404, 2752). Test: `/testbed/test/main/services/team/TeamMcpConfigBuilder.test.ts`.

Project context: Electron + React + TypeScript repo rooted at `/testbed`, pnpm/vitest, team services under `src/main/services/team/` with barrel `index.ts`.
